title: LMS-NG MQTT state v2
description: Published to telemetry/elevators/{elevatorId}/state on every accepted debounced change and on the board's periodic re-emit. NOT retained on this topic (see snapshot.schema.json for the retained latest-value copy). The Edge sends floorRaw and real contact readings ONLY -- floorDisplay/floorKind/floorProfileVersion are Backend-computed and never appear here (revised plan section A.7, corrects a v1-baseline inconsistency documented in docs/preflight/CONTRACT_BASELINE_DIFF.md section 4).

SAFETY_DEVICE.description: true means the physical contact reads closed. This is NOT a certification that the lift is safe -- it is a raw contact reading (revised plan section A.7).

FIRE_OPERATION.description: Present only when capabilities.FIRE_OPERATION.available is true. Real building: never present today -- FIRE pins have never been physically activated/identified.

statusPoints.description: Only keys that actually exist on this elevator's wiring are present -- a real elevator never carries a DOOR_OPEN key (there is no door signal on this hardware). Simulated elevators may include DOOR_OPEN.

capabilities.description: Per signal-point capability flags, e.g. {"FIRE_OPERATION": {"available": false, "reason": "pin not identified"}}. Lets a consumer distinguish 'this signal is false' from 'this signal does not exist on this elevator'.

positionBitSuspect.description: Diagnostic candidate only (POSITION_BIT_SUSPECT flag). Never auto-corrects floorRaw and never alone raises a SENSOR fault alarm without independent/operator confirmation (revised plan section B.5, test G13).

boardMs.description: Board's own millis() counter, uint32, wraps at 2^32 (~49.7 days) -- a wrap is NOT a reboot (test G06).

changeId.description: Deterministic: derived from this message's messageId + array index, so re-delivery of the same state record yields byte-identical changeIds (revised plan section A.3, avoids double-counting against the events topic).

changes.description: Per-signal changes derived alongside this state record, committed atomically with it by the Backend in one transaction. This is what makes the removed per-signal-point MQTT topic (v1 baseline) unnecessary -- see docs/preflight/CONTRACT_BASELINE_DIFF.md section 3.

reemit.description: true when this record's raw mask is unchanged from the previous one -- i.e. it is the board's periodic re-emit (idle baseline) or the boot-time baseline, not an actual signal change.
